entries.text: CPU went from 41% to 97% while the request rate barely moved, and the cache hit ratio fell from 94% to zero in the same window [e1]. Pull request 903 set PRICING_CACHE_ENABLED=false at 12:15 [e2]. CPU is the symptom here and not the cause: with the cache disabled every request recomputes prices.

structured.root_cause: a configuration change disabled the pricing cache, so every request recomputes prices
structured.summary: The cache hit ratio fell to zero at the moment CPU rose, with the request rate flat [e1], and pull request 903 disabled the pricing cache by configuration at 12:15 [e2]. CPU is the symptom and not the cause; the docs change in the same window is unrelated.
causal_chain: every request recomputed prices instead of reading the cache
CPU saturated at an unchanged request rate
remediation_steps: re-enable PRICING_CACHE_ENABLED and point it at the migrated cluster
